candidates.description: This vector represents common Italian grammatical words, prepositions, and auxiliary verbs.
This vector is related to adjectives of scale, size, magnitude, or importance across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents subword tokens containing the Spanish or Romance root "entr-" or "cent-".
This vector represents common Italian nominal and adverbial derivational suffixes.
This feature vector represents adjective suffixes and relational stems often associated with comparison, similarity, or compatibility.
The feature vector represents Italian adjectival and nominal suffixes and suffix-like morphemes.
This vector represents linguistic syllables or phonetic prefixes starting with the letter 'i'.
This feature vector represents subword tokens and prefixes starting with or resembling the letters "oc" or "occ".
This vector activates on words containing the character sequence "i" followed by a double consonant or "s" sound, often associated with French-derived or Latinate roots.
This feature vector represents Italian adverbs and adverbial suffixes expressing manner, degree, or time.
